Subject: Request: compact VM evidence + remediation attestation for SOC 2 SIG

Hi Chloe,

We're preparing to close the SOC 2 SIG for Finex and need a concise evidence package from Redwood covering vulnerability management. Specifically we need: 1) scan cadence (tools/vendors), 2) proof that all Critical/High CVEs discovered in the last 90 days are tracked with owners and closure timelines, and 3) a formal attestation of your remediation SLA for Critical/High findings.

Can you send a compact bundle we can upload to the SIG portal (CSV + short narrative + attestations)? If possible, include the last scanned snapshot, a short mapping of CVEs -> responsible team -> status, and any exceptions/accepted risks. We need this by EOD Tuesday (2026-12-14) to meet our internal audit cut-off.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Arjun

Quick notes on scope: the attestation covers Redwood-hosted API and Dedicated capacity. Private deployments (on-prem/VPC) are covered under the customer's control plane and will be noted as "out of scope" unless you requested a separate attestation.

Remediation SLA (short form):
- Critical (CVSS >= 9.0 or P0 exploitability): mitigation plan within 72 hours; remediation or compensating control within 7 business days.
- High (7.0–8.9): remediation plan within 5 business days; remediation within 14 calendar days.
- Medium/Low: standard 30/60-day cadence depending on risk tier.

Marissa is assembling the closure manifest and will attach the scanner vendor's verification. Monica will add a short narrative on detection cadence and evidence retention. We'll aim to deliver the full bundle by 2026-12-14 10:00 PT. If you need a DocuSign for the attestation, note that in a reply.

—Chloe

Arjun —

Attached is the compact evidence bundle for Finex's SOC 2 SIG upload:
- redwood_vm_scan_snapshot_20261208.zip (scanner outputs + summary CSV)
- cve_closure_manifest_20261214.csv (CVE ID, CVSS, severity label, owner, first-seen, status, remediation ticket, remediation ETA)
- sla_attestation_20261214.pdf (signed; covers Redwood-hosted API and Redwood Dedicated clusters)

Key attestation points (summary):
- Scan cadence: authenticated full-net scans weekly for production control plane and nightly credentialed sweeps on exposed assets; continuous internal pipeline scans on PR.
- Evidence retention: raw scan outputs retained 12 months in secure evidence storage; summary CSVs retained 36 months for SOC review.
- SLA (attested): Critical — mitigation plan within 72 hours; remediation or compensating control within 7 business days. High — remediation plan within 5 business days; remediation within 14 calendar days. Exceptions require documented risk acceptance and are tracked in the closure manifest.
- Scope: attestation limited to Redwood-managed environments (hosted + Dedicated). Private customer-managed deployments are out-of-scope unless separately commissioned.

We've included a compact CSV mapping for each finding that was classified Critical/High in the last 90 days with owner and ticket link. For the six Critical items flagged by our vendor: two are fixed and verified (tickets closed), three have mitigation controls in place and are scheduled for remediation during the 2026-12-16 patch window, and one is queued with an assigned owner and ETA (2026-12-21) due to required infra coordination. All of these are reflected in cve_closure_manifest_20261214.csv.

If you would like a short formal signature via DocuSign on the PDF attestation, we can generate that by EOD tomorrow. Otherwise consider this email and attached signed PDF as our formal attestation for the requested SIG entry.

Thanks — and let me know if you need any additional mapping (e.g., specific CVE->CWE notes or exploitability evidence).

—Chloe
